The BELS Teaching Lab Junior Engineer supports more than 20 lab courses across multiple departments and instructional spaces, directly impacting more than 1,600 students each quarter. The incumbent oversees specialized equipment, test and measurement instrumentation, and software essential for instructional purposes. These tools are crucial for hands-on learning, the practical application of theoretical concepts, building core technical competencies, and enhancing the quality of education provided by Baskin Engineering.
